prompt: Photograph of an architect's presentation model on a dark green self-healing cutting mat. A white cutaway model of a courtroom with no roof: a judge's bench, a witness box, two counsel tables and rows of public benches, built from clean white foamboard and museum card with crisp knife-cut edges. On one counsel table sits a neat stack of tiny white paper files. A large round magnifying lens on a slim stand, its rim bright cutter-yellow, stands over the stack of files. The lens rim is the only yellow part. A few tiny scale-model figures of a man in a navy suit stand at the tables. Three-quarter elevated view. Soft north-window daylight from the upper left, gentle soft shadows on the mat, tilt-shift shallow depth of field, studio product photography. The mat is plain deep green with only a very faint fine grid. No text, no numbers, no logos, no hands, no tools.
